title: HP 422 Blue Haven - Vacation Rental in High Pointe Resort,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… "HP 422 Blue Haven" at High Pointe Resort in Seacrest Beach! Experience stunning ocean views, relax by the lagoon-style pool, and embrace the laid-back coastal lifestyle. This 2-suite condo sleeps up to 8 guests and offers private resort beach access for endless sun-soaked days. Explore nearby Rosemary and Alys Beaches, where boutique shopping, top-notch dining, and picture-perfect sunsets await. Perfect for family getaways or group retreats—this is your dream beach escape! Learn more below... *** HIGHLIGHTS ***Breathtaking Gulf Views from the balcony, offering a serene escape overlooking the sparkling lagoon-style poolExpansive Resort Pool featuring a luxurious hot tub, a playful kiddie pool, and a tranquil waterfall for ultimate relaxationExclusive Beach Access with a private community path leading to sugar-white sands and the on-site beachfront bar & grill, Crabby Steve's—perfect for laid-back coastal diningPrime Location nestled near the charming communities of Rosemary and Alys Beaches, surrounded by vibrant shops and local attractionsModern Luxury Interiors with designer furnishings and a fully updated kitchen, providing a chic and comfortable home away from homeEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Absolutely stunning condo with breathtaking views! The location couldn’t have been more perfect, the pool was incredible, and the communication was seamless. Highly recommend!" – Christina⭐"We absolutely loved this immaculate and beautifully maintained property! It’s close to great restaurants and shops, plus the Gulf view was spectacular." – Jan⭐"This condo at High Pointe is hands down our favorite! From the amazing pool and stunning views to the unbeatable experience at Crabby Steve’s, everything was pure perfection!" – Jana*** LIVING AREA ***Step into a stunning open-concept living space bathed in natural light, offering sweeping views of the Gulf and the sparkling pool. Start your day with a peaceful coffee as the sun rises, or unwind with loved ones for cozy movie nights. Every corner of this space is thoughtfully designed to inspire relaxation, foster connection, and make every moment unforgettable.Spacious and inviting living room featuring stylish designer furnishings for a touch of eleganceOversized flat-screen TV, perfect for cozy family movie nights or binge-watching your favorite showsStep directly onto the Gulf-view balcony, complete with a coffee table for 4 and plenty of comfortable seating to soak in the stunning scenery*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Whip up gourmet creations or quick family favorites in the stunning, modern kitchen, complete with elegant quartz countertops and top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances. Savor your meals with breathtaking Gulf views, whether you're gathered around the spacious indoor dining table or enjoying a casual bite at the stylish breakfast bar.Modern, fully equipped kitchen featuring premium stainless steel appliancesElegant quartz countertops with ample prep space for all your cooking needsSpacious dining table for 6, complemented by a stylish breakfast bar seating 3*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Every bedroom is designed with comfort in mind, offering plush bedding, high-quality linens, and soothing, sophisticated décor. The bathrooms provide a sleek, spa-like escape, complete with rainfall showers, spacious countertops, and all the necessities for a refreshing experience.Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, gulf-front balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities and shower/tub comboBunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Queen Bunk Beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity, shower/tub combo and additional hall access*** HIGH POINTE RESORT OVERVIEW ***High Pointe Resort delivers an unparalleled experience with top-tier amenities designed to make your stay truly unforgettable. Dive into a stunning tropical lagoon-style pool, enjoy exclusive private beach access, and indulge in a variety of outdoor activities. Every detail is crafted to create the perfect getaway just for you.Exclusive Gulf Side Resort in a Gated Community in Seacrest BeachExpansive Pool Deck Featuring a Large Pool, Serene Waterfall, Kiddie Pool, and Relaxing Hot TubBeach Front Bar and Grill – Crabby Steve’s, Serving Delicious Meals with Stunning Ocean ViewsExclusive Private Beach Boardwalk for Convenience and PrivacyAmenity-rich 15-Acre Tropical Paradise Perfect for Families and Beach EnthusiastsWell-Maintained Tennis Court and Four Pickleball Courts for Sports LoversChildren's Playground for the Little OnesShuffleboard Court for Family FunBBQ Grills - Charcoal for Outdoor Dining*** LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ***Nestled in Seacrest Beach, "HP 422 Blue Haven" offers the perfect gateway to 30A’s most enchanting destinations. Stroll through the iconic Rosemary and Alys Beaches, where you’ll discover boutique shops, indulgent world-class dining, and breathtaking coastal vistas. Experience the charm, beauty, and relaxation that make this area unforgettable.Peddlers Pavilion (Right Across the Street) – A lively gathering place, offering a diverse selection of vendors that appeal to both locals and tourists, complemented by live music on most summer evenings.Rosemary Beach (6 min walk) – Cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a relaxed vibeAlys Beach (0.9 mile) – Elegant architecture and serene atmosphereCarillon Beach (8 min drive) – Peaceful white sands and stunning views*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentBicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce VitaLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 207836
